name: Lifezone Metals Limited
summary: Lifezone Metals Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the metals production and recycling business. The company's flagship project is the Kabanga Nickel Project located in north-west Tanzania. It is also involved in the intellectual property licensing business. The company is based in Douglas, Isle of Man.

top_holders.holder: Grantham, Mayo, Van Otterloo & Co. LLC
